note: The google-cloud MCP server answers in prose with a row preview; `bq` returns JSON. Requires the emulator started for this task: uv run python server/fakes/gcp.py ab-testing. Every google-cloud projection ends in `grep .`, so an arm whose reply carries no such line fails the case instead of agreeing on nothing.

cases.name: run_query_count
cases.why: the same statement returns the same answer through either arm

args.query: SELECT COUNT(*) AS n FROM ab_testing.ab_Books

mirage.command: google-cloud bigquery-run-query '{"query":"SELECT COUNT(*) AS n FROM ab_testing.ab_Books"}'

cases.name: clicks_by_window
cases.why: the clickstream the answer is computed from agrees value for value

args.query: SELECT A_clicks FROM ab_testing.ab_Books ORDER BY time_window LIMIT 3

mirage.command: google-cloud bigquery-run-query '{"query":"SELECT A_clicks FROM ab_testing.ab_Books ORDER BY time_window LIMIT 3"}'

cases.name: promo_bucket_absent
cases.why: the answer's winning branch is 'a bucket with this prefix exists', so both arms must start with none -- and it is the seed's prefix delete, not a name, that makes that true
cases.note: the bucket count proves the reply is a listing; the names, if any, are the ones that would decide the task
